open_pr: If the PR is open, check the current head for findings awaiting a required Builder answer. Include Nits even when the `Reviewer` status is successful.

cases.same-head Nit awaiting a Builder answer: For each missing answer, follow [Answering findings](review.md#answering-findings). After a repair push, follow [Rounds](review.md#rounds) on the new head.
cases.same-head Nit already answered by the Bu: When every required answer is present on the current head, resume the merge wait where supported without replying again.
